Prompts.Name: What can you do?
Prompts.Text: What can you do in Joktan? Give me a short list, with an example of each.

Prompts.Name: Summarise the alerts
Prompts.Text: Summarise the latest alerts and messages, most important first.

Prompts.Name: Note the alerts
Prompts.Text: Make a note of today's alerts.

Prompts.Name: Check the certificates
Prompts.Text: List the certificates that have expired or expire within 30 days.

Prompts.Name: Check the MQTT clients
Prompts.Text: Which MQTT clients are connected, and which are not?

Prompts.Name: Check the containers
Prompts.Text: Which containers are running, and do any look unwell?
